name: native-profile-bootstrap
goal: Normal profiling configuration starts without native Node TypeScript support, while retaining root and inherited-workspace evidence and worker limits.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Adoption commitadbe75a1 dynamically imports a typed startup entry and passed on local Node25 with native type stripping. Disabling that capability reproduces ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION in the product bootstrap; installed Vite can compile its implementation without requiring native TS.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Expand existing normal workspace-configuration test across native startup capabilities, using the host-supported disabling flag when available. Each root/inherited execution must start and add fresh observations; assert product startup errors explicitly. This is a product loading defect, not a missing fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Initial47273755 proof0bef7885 establishes native TS startup failure. Latest lint-compliant test/fixture commitdcc22749 re-sealed asa658c9f6 with both owning test and shared fixture named; ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION still proves the product boundary failure.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep a native JavaScript startup entry, ask the installed Vite loader to compile typed tooling, and remove the native typed hop. Preserve frozen root/workspace configs and each execution capture assertion.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: All27 focused integration cases pass together, including native TS disabled. Types, lint, audit and registry pass; skill validates. Existing SDK API source is unchanged from its successful packed-consumer check.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
